notes.title: Postponement announcement
notes.notes:
Hello you guys,

Thank you for your attention on Tayutama2 -you’re the only one-ENG ver.

Since the release of the trial version, we’ve received lots of feedback by various methods. We’re so happy that lots of people love the game and anticipate the release. Meanwhile, you guys care about the game, and hope the quality of the game will be higher as it goes on sale. For which, we’ve decided to take more time to improve it.

This is the first English product for us. Due to the lack of the experience, we feel deeply sorry that we can’t satisfy the game’s fans within the expected time. 

Next, according to the Japanese trial version, we’re going to gradually release the improved trial versions, and the length will be longer and longer. By which you can see the process of our improvement work.

Therefore, the official release date will be from 2017December to 2018Q1th.

We appreciate your understanding.

Hope you all Merry Christmas & Happy New Year!

See you in 2018.

Best Regards,
HIKARI FIELD

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31276878/a5bc4ca916d466a5c9230071e48a8da26684fb56.jpg[/img]

notes.title: The store page of
notes.notes:
Thank you all very much for having been waiting patiently so far. We appreciate your understanding.

The store of <Tayutama2 -you're the only one-> ENG ver. is officially OPEN today!

The game is produced by our company's original engine that is based on unity and combines new features such as Steam Cloud & Achivement , it has several features below:
[list]
[*][b]Providing the Mac OS version[/b]

 [*][b]Supporting the Steam Achievement[/b] 

 [*][b]Supporting the Steam Cloud[/b]

 [*][b]Supporting the operation of joystick, so you can enjoy the game on a large screen[/b]

 [*][b]Compatible with ultra-high resolution in full screen mode, so you can enjoy the more clearer fonts[/b]

 [*][b]The insolvable CHI Ver. bug which is due to technology limitations no longer exists.[/b]
[/list]
We start to provide the download of the trial version now. There're two options for you: PC version or Mac version. Have a try!​
